headline: Candid Talk, LPS Chief Reveals Policy Direction in the Financial Sector
summary: LPS chairman Anggito Abimanyu outlined the strategy for the financial sector in 2027. Priorities include digitalization, financial inclusion and policy insurance guarantees to support banking stability.
why: LPS is Indonesia's deposit insurance agency, which protects bank depositors and supports banking-system stability.
original_headline: Buka-Bukaan, Bos LPS Ungkap Arah Kebijakan di Sektor Keuangan
